name: seerr
description: Overseerr / Jellyseerr media request management for your Plex or Jellyfin ecosystem — search movies and TV shows, check availability and request status, browse trending and popular titles, and create, approve, or decline media requests. Authenticates with your instance's admin-scoped API key (X-Api-Key header, Settings > General > API Key), so request approval and creation act with admin rights. Self-hosted: your Overseerr/Jellyseerr server must be reachable from Sophon's sandbox (LAN/VPN-only hosts usually need a reverse proxy or tunnel). Media metadata originates from TMDB via your server.
author: Buildersoft LLC

fields.label: Server URL
fields.helpText: Root URL of your Overseerr or Jellyseerr server, without a trailing slash. Must be reachable from Sophon's sandbox — LAN/VPN-only hosts usually need a reverse proxy or tunnel.

fields.label: API Key
fields.helpText: Copy from Settings > General > API Key in Overseerr/Jellyseerr. This key is admin-scoped.

tools.name: seerr.search_media
tools.description: Search movies and TV shows by title via your Seerr server (TMDB-backed). Returns id, media type, title, release date, overview, and current availability status.

query.description: Search text, e.g. a movie or show title

tools.name: seerr.get_media_status
tools.description: Get availability and request status for a specific movie or TV show by its TMDB id.

mediaType.description: Whether the TMDB id is a movie or a TV show

tmdbId.description: TMDB id of the title (from seerr.search_media)

tools.name: seerr.list_requests
tools.description: List media requests on the server — id, type, request status, media title/availability, and who requested it.

skip.description: Number of requests to skip for paging (default 0)

filter.description: Only return requests in this state

tools.name: seerr.get_trending
tools.description: Browse discovery feeds from your Seerr server: trending titles (mixed), popular movies, or popular TV shows.

feed.description: Which discovery feed to browse (default trending)

tools.name: seerr.create_request
tools.description: Create a media request for a movie or TV show by TMDB id. Runs with the admin API key, so the request may be auto-approved per server settings.

mediaId.description: TMDB id of the title to request

seasons.description: TV only: 'all' to request every season, or a list of season numbers, e.g. [1, 2]

tools.name: seerr.approve_request
tools.description: Approve a pending media request (admin action — the server starts processing the download).

requestId.description: Id of the request to approve (from seerr.list_requests)

tools.name: seerr.decline_request
tools.description: Decline a pending media request (admin action).

requestId.description: Id of the request to decline (from seerr.list_requests)
